title: Never Compromise to Vulnerabilities: A Comprehensive Survey on AI Governance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating gender translation accuracy across languages (e.g., MT-GenEval benchmark), assessing generated text for gender biases (e.g., FairPrism benchmark), and measuring group fairness disparities in face recognition models (e.g., Fair SA framework).

Measuring performance disparities in face recognition based on skin tone (e.g., Fair SA framework), analyzing variations in generated sentence lengths for specific ethnic names (e.g., Hispanic names in prompt engineering), and testing object detection and autonomous vehicle performance on darker-skinned pedestrians.
Assessing generated text for bias types and harm extent using targeted text generation benchmarks like FairPrism.

Using question answering benchmarks (e.g., BBQ, KoBBQ) to assess social bias against protected classes via bias scores, and evaluating image classifiers and large vision-language models across diverse demographic groups (e.g., FewSTAB, FACET, and VLBiasBench).
